proposed_widenings.name: bearer-triggered early end for active timed item effects
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can represent a timed activated effect, but not an active effect that the bearer may end early by spending a Magic action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The wings last for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a Magic action.

proposed_widenings.name: post-effect randomized cooldown reset cadence
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's reuse lockout begins when the effect ends and lasts a dice-rolled number of hours; existing reset cadences only cover rests, dawn, or never.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When the wings disappear, you can't use them again for 1d12 hours.

notes: Did not author placeholder content. The item mostly matches a magic-item activation with timed fly-speed grant, but the current surface cannot represent its early self-dismiss action or end-triggered 1d12-hour reuse lockout honestly. The fall-when-aloft rider matches existing DM-agenda omissions in Fly and Potion of Flying precedents.
